headline: Board briefed on state hearing over ditch system ownership

meeting.body: 'Aha Wai o Maui Hikina East Maui Regional Community Board (Water Authority)
meeting.summary: The board heard a briefing on a state land board meeting about the ditch system, adopted the director's evaluation, and went into closed session.
meeting.recap: The board heard a briefing on the April 24, 2026 meeting of the state Board of Land and Natural Resources (BLNR).[[0:01:58]] Staff said a foundation committed $100,000 to the water authority for early planning work.[[1:00:57]] The next board meeting is June 19th.[[1:17:11]] The board voted to go into executive session (a closed-door discussion) about property negotiations tied to the irrigation system.[[1:19:38]]
decided: The board agreed to move item 4B to the end of the agenda.
The board voted to go into executive session on property negotiations.
meeting.next: Staff may work with the parks department on timing for the community meetings. One signed copy of the evaluation report goes to the mayor and council. The director's idea of a finance committee could be put on next month's agenda. Staff are preparing a proposal with basic financial information for the foundation this month. The board secretary will email the training information to board members.

moments.q: "If you need us to run, we can, but we prefer to walk."
